item.title: Paramount concedes to save $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
item.description: Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to resolve a lawsuit that threatened the media company's acquisition bid.

item.title: World leaders meet for UNGA; Trump calls D.C. arch a 'military complex'
item.description: World leaders gather for the U.N. General Assembly amid ongoing wars in Ukraine and the Gulf, while President Trump proposes his arch be a 'military complex.'

item.title: Aviation regulators adopt AI to manage national airspace
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration has launched an $875 million initiative to improve U.S. airspace efficiency, though critics question its effectiveness.

item.title: GOP candidates echo Trump's 2020 claims as voters seek to move on
item.description: Many Republican candidates in key races continue to support Trump's unfounded election integrity claims, though some in the party differ.
